status: 겨울에 드물게 찾아옴, 지금까지 기록 10건 미만
habitat: 줄과 갈대가 우거진 호소·소택지, 하구 물가
summary: 줄과 갈대가 우거진 호소나 소택지, 하구의 물가에 사는 뜸부기로, 봄과 가을에 우리나라 중서부를 지나간다. 일부 작은 무리는 낙동강 하구와 주남저수지 등 남부 낙동강 유역에서 겨울을 난다. 갈대밭 땅 위나 쌓인 갈대 위에 갈잎과 줄기로 접시 모양 둥지를 틀고 한배에 알 6~7개를 낳는다. 물고기, 새우류, 복족류, 곤충 같은 동물성 먹이와 여러 식물의 씨앗을 먹으며, 유라시아, 우수리, 사할린 등 온대 지역에서 번식한다.

art.subject: Water Rail (Rallus aquaticus), adult of the East Asian form (Rallus aquaticus indicus, Brown-cheeked Rail): crown and upperparts olive-brown with broad black feather centres, giving a streaked back; a broad slate-grey supercilium; a dark brown stripe from the lores through the eye to the ear-coverts; cheeks slate-grey; chin and throat white; breast and belly pale grey washed brownish; flanks boldly barred black and white; undertail coverts white. Bill long, red on the lower mandible and the base of the upper mandible, with a dark culmen and tip; iris red; legs and feet apricot-brown.
art.pose: walking at the edge of a reed bed, picking food from the shallows
art.scene: Korean estuary or marsh edge with dense reeds and wild rice; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view walking: olive-brown back with black streaks, slate-grey supercilium and cheeks, dark brown stripe through the eye, white throat, pale grey underparts with black-and-white barred flanks, long red-based bill, apricot-brown legs
adult, head detail: broad slate-grey supercilium, dark brown stripe from the lores through the eye to the ear-coverts, white chin and throat, red eye, long bill red at the base with a dark culmen
art.build: Slim, laterally compressed rail, about 29cm, slightly smaller and much slimmer than a Common Moorhen. Bill long, longer than the head, slender and very slightly decurved. Legs medium length, with long toes. Wings short and rounded, hidden on the flanks at rest. Tail short, often flicked up to show the white undertail. Moves stealthily with the body held low and horizontal.
avoid: Do not paint the bill all black or blackish-brown on this adult; it is red at the base with a dark culmen.
Do not paint a short, stubby crake bill; the bill is long and slender.
Do not paint the plain grey face of the western Water Rail; the East Asian form has a dark brown eye-stripe.
Do not paint unbarred flanks; they are boldly barred black and white.
